title: Storage class
purpose: Review one storage class and the units that use it.
summary: One storage class and the units that use it.

tasks.title: Find a unit in this class
steps: Select its code under Storage units, or select [[All units in this class]] to open the filtered register.
Search by code or name to find a unit beyond the preview.

tasks.title: Change the class
steps: Admin and manager: select [[Edit]], change it and give a reason.

good_to_know: Retired units appear in the preview and the register. The Active storage units count excludes them.
The code is fixed and never reused.
Classes are never deleted. Clear Active to stop offering one.
Open [[History]] and use [[Next page]] if you need to see older changes.

items.label: Active storage units
items.description: Number of active units of this class.

sections.title: Storage units
paragraphs: The preview lists up to 100 active and retired units in code order. Each row shows the unit code, name, room and status. The heading says “First 100 shown” when more units belong to the class.
When the class has units, All units in this class opens the Storage units register with this class and both statuses selected. Search, sort or page through all matching units there.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Admin and manager roles. Opens the class form.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: Each entry shows the action, its time, who made the change and any reason given. History cannot be edited or deleted. If there are no entries, the panel shows No recorded changes yet.

History shows the latest changes first, with up to 50 entries per page. Within each page, entries run from oldest to newest. If there are more than 50 changes, the heading shows the total. Next page shows older changes and Previous page shows newer ones. First page returns to the latest changes and Last page opens the oldest.
On opening the record, History starts collapsed if it has more than five entries. Select the heading to open or close it. Using a History page link keeps History open.
